ITEM 1 | Shredded pale cream-to-golden mass with thin strands and some browned crispy edges, spread across the lower right of the plate, covering about 30% of plate area, roughly 2 cm tall in a mound, moist-looking and loosely clumped, sitting beside the greens | 110
ITEM 2 | Wilted dark green leafy greens with burgundy-purple edges and some reddish-orange small pieces scattered through, glossy and limp, piled in the upper right, covering about 20% of plate area, roughly 2 cm tall, sitting on top of and beside the pale shredded mass | 60
ITEM 3 | Single small dark purple-black berry-like piece with a green leafy tip, about 2 cm long, slightly glossy and soft, sitting alone on the left side of the plate | 8
ITEM 4 | Thin pale translucent strands with a few light specks, a small wispy streak near the top left edge of the greens, about 4 cm long, dry-looking and fragile | 3
